title: Contents Packout & Storage Return Truck Loads
content:
**Scope.** This Contents Packout & Storage policy prices the truck loads that bring the contents of a Partial Contents Packout, Full Contents Packout, High-Value Contents Packout or Commercial Contents and Records Recovery job home, and only those: they are booked as one move-back line with charge code `truck_trip` once the job is in returned status, dated the job's returned date, at most once per return.

For the truck loads that bring a job's contents home, and only for those, the loads and the line amount are figured by the return truck-load rule and booked as one move-back line; every other truck trip is still billed per load. For the move-back truck line of a return, and only for that line, the line is charged once the job is in returned status; every packout, cleaning or disposal line is still charged only while the job is in authorized, in custody or return scheduled status.

| Line | When it may be charged | How it is booked |
|---|---|---|
| truck loads bringing the contents home (move-back truck line) | once the job is in returned status, dated the returned date, at most once per return | one move-back line for all the loads |
| any other truck trip | while the job is authorized, in custody or return scheduled | per load, as a packout line |

## Booking the line: `charge_return_truck_loads_2b0047ce`

**Capability.** The tool books the truck loads that brought a contents job home as one move-back line: it adds one move-back charge with charge code `truck_trip`, dated the day the loads were delivered, to the named contents job, and raises the job's balance due by the same amount. The customer can see the new move-back line and the higher balance on the job straight away. A second call for the same job, date and amount books nothing new: it returns status `already_booked` with that line's id and leaves the balance due unchanged.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `charge_return_truck_loads_2b0047ce` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contents_job_id` | the reference number of the contents job the move-back line belongs to, as returned by the contents job lookup | identifier |
| `service_date` | the date the move-back work was performed | calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |
| `amount` | the line amount in USD | a positive figure rounded to 2 decimal places, half up |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (booked when the line was added), `contents_charge_id` (reference number of the new move-back line), `contents_job_id`, `charge_code` (always `truck_trip`), `service_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (after the line, USD, 2 decimal places). A repeated call with the same job, date and amount returns status `already_booked` with the existing line's `contents_charge_id`, `contents_job_id`, `amount` and the unchanged `balance_due`.

**Errors.** "service_date must be a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD."; "amount must be a positive USD figure."
